```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_expansion AS (
    -- Base case: direct components of FR-M63S-38
    SELECT 
        b.component_id,
        b.per_assembly_qty AS qty
    FROM bill_of_materials b
    JOIN product p ON p.product_id = b.assembly_id
    WHERE p.product_number = 'FR-M63S-38'
      AND b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')
      AND b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    -- Recursive case: components of components (only for made-in-house assemblies)
    SELECT 
        b.component_id,
        be.qty * b.per_assembly_qty
    FROM bom_expansion be
    JOIN product p_comp ON p_comp.product_id = be.component_id
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = be.component_id
    WHERE p_comp.make_flag = TRUE
      AND b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR b.end_date >= DATE '2025-06-30')
      AND b.assembly_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    SUM(be.qty) AS total_qty
FROM bom_expansion be
JOIN product p ON p.product_id = be.component_id
WHERE p.product_number = 'MS-2341';
```

    FROM product

),
explode AS (

    FROM cur_bom b

    WHERE e.depth < 50
)

WITH RECURSIVE
-- Get the product_id for part MS-2348
target_part AS (
    SELECT product_id
    FROM product
    WHERE product_number = 'MS-2348'
),
-- Get orders from Central territory in 2025
central_orders AS (
    SELECT so.order_id, so.order_date, sol.product_id, sol.order_qty
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory st ON so.territory_id = st.territory_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Central'
      AND so.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
      AND so.order_date < '2026-01-01'
),
-- Recursive CTE to traverse BOM for each order line product
bom_traversal AS (
    -- Base case: the product sold directly
    SELECT 
        co.order_id,
        co.order_date,
        co.product_id AS root_product_id,
        co.product_id AS current_product_id,
        co.order_qty AS qty_multiplier,
        1 AS bom_level
    FROM central_orders co
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: traverse BOM components
    SELECT 
        bt.order_id,
        bt.order_date,
        bt.root_product_id,
        bom.component_id AS current_product_id,
        bt.qty_multiplier * bom.per_assembly_qty AS qty_multiplier,
        bt.bom_level + 1
    FROM bom_traversal bt
    JOIN bill_of_materials bom ON bt.current_product_id = bom.assembly_id
    WHERE bom.start_date <= bt.order_date
      AND (bom.end_date IS NULL OR bt.order_date <= bom.end_date)
)
-- Sum up all demand for the target part
SELECT 
    SUM(bt.qty_multiplier) AS total_demand
FROM bom_traversal bt
JOIN target_part tp ON bt.current_product_id = tp.product_id;
```

WITH RECURSIVE
-- Get the product IDs for the target assembly and the part
target_product AS (
    SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'FR-M94B-46'
),
part_product AS (
    SELECT product_id FROM product WHERE product_number = 'MS-1981'
),
-- Recursive CTE to calculate total quantity of part per unit of assembly for a given date
bom_calc AS (
    -- Base case: direct components of the target assembly
    SELECT 
        b.component_id,
        b.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty,
        b.bom_level
    FROM bill_of_materials b
    CROSS JOIN target_product tp
    WHERE b.assembly_id = tp.product_id
      AND b.start_date <= '2021-08-08'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR '2021-08-08' <= b.end_date)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: components of components
    SELECT 
        b.component_id,
        bc.total_qty * b.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty,
        bc.bom_level + 1
    FROM bom_calc bc
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON bc.component_id = b.assembly_id
    WHERE b.start_date <= '2021-08-08'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR '2021-08-08' <= b.end_date)
),
earlier_qty AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(bc.total_qty), 0) AS qty
    FROM bom_calc bc
    JOIN part_product pp ON bc.component_id = pp.product_id
),
bom_calc_current AS (
    -- Base case: direct components of the target assembly
    SELECT 
        b.component_id,
        b.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty,
        b.bom_level
    FROM bill_of_materials b
    CROSS JOIN target_product tp
    WHERE b.assembly_id = tp.product_id
      AND b.start_date <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR '2025-06-30' <= b.end_date)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: components of components
    SELECT 
        b.component_id,
        bc.total_qty * b.per_assembly_qty AS total_qty,
        bc.bom_level + 1
    FROM bom_calc_current bc
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON bc.component_id = b.assembly_id
    WHERE b.start_date <= '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR '2025-06-30' <= b.end_date)
),
current_qty AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(bc.total_qty), 0) AS qty
    FROM bom_calc_current bc
    JOIN part_product pp ON bc.component_id = pp.product_id
)
SELECT current_qty.qty - earlier_qty.qty AS change_in_qty
FROM current_qty, earlier_qty;

-- Get the product IDs
products AS (
    SELECT product_id, product_number
    FROM product
    WHERE product_number IN ('MS-0253', 'BK-R89B-44')

-- Recursive BOM expansion for a given date
bom_expansion AS (
    -- Base: direct components of the assembly
    SELECT 
        p.product_id AS assembly_id,
        b.component_id,
        b.per_assembly_qty AS qty,
        1 AS level
    FROM bill_of_materials b
    JOIN products p ON p.product_number = 'BK-R89B-44'
    WHERE b.assembly_id = p.product_id
      AND b.start_date <= DATE '2021-10-16'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR DATE '2021-10-16' <= b.end_date)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: components of components (only for made-in-house parts)
    SELECT 
        be.assembly_id,
        b.component_id,
        be.qty * b.per_assembly_qty,
        be.level + 1
    FROM bom_expansion be
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = be.component_id
    JOIN product comp ON comp.product_id = be.component_id
    WHERE comp.make_flag = TRUE
      AND b.start_date <= DATE '2021-10-16'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR DATE '2021-10-16' <= b.end_date)
),
-- Sum quantities of MS-0253 for the earlier date
earlier_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(be.qty) AS total_qty
    FROM bom_expansion be
    JOIN products p ON p.product_id = be.component_id
    WHERE p.product_number = 'MS-0253'
),
-- Recursive BOM expansion for current date (2025-06-30)
bom_expansion_current AS (
    -- Base: direct components of the assembly
    SELECT 
        p.product_id AS assembly_id,
        b.component_id,
        b.per_assembly_qty AS qty,
        1 AS level
    FROM bill_of_materials b
    JOIN products p ON p.product_number = 'BK-R89B-44'
    WHERE b.assembly_id = p.product_id
      AND b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR DATE '2025-06-30' <= b.end_date)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: components of components (only for made-in-house parts)
    SELECT 
        be.assembly_id,
        b.component_id,
        be.qty * b.per_assembly_qty,
        be.level + 1
    FROM bom_expansion_current be
    JOIN bill_of_materials b ON b.assembly_id = be.component_id
    JOIN product comp ON comp.product_id = be.component_id
    WHERE comp.make_flag = TRUE
      AND b.start_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'
      AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR DATE '2025-06-30' <= b.end_date)
),
-- Sum quantities of MS-0253 for the current date

    FROM bom_expansion_current be
    JOIN products p ON p.product_id = be.component_id
    WHERE p.product_number = 'MS-0253'
)

WITH RECURSIVE
bom_edges AS (
    SELECT 
        p1.product_number AS parent_code,
        p2.product_number AS child_code,
        u.qty
    FROM u_composition u

      AND (u.valid_to IS NULL OR u.valid_to >= '2025-06-30')

    FROM bom_edges
    WHERE parent_code = 'BK-T44U-46'

    JOIN bom_t44u b ON be.parent_code = b.child_code

bom_m18b AS (
    SELECT child_code, qty
    FROM bom_edges
    WHERE parent_code = 'BK-M18B-52'
    UNION ALL

    FROM bom_edges be
    JOIN bom_m18b b ON be.parent_code = b.child_code
),
parts_t44u AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.product_number
    FROM bom_t44u b
    JOIN product p ON b.child_code = p.product_number
    WHERE p.make_flag = FALSE
),

WITH RECURSIVE
lines AS (
    SELECT p.product_number AS code,
           so.order_date    AS d,
           SUM(sol.order_qty)::DOUBLE AS qty
    FROM sales_order so
    JOIN sales_territory st  ON st.territory_id = so.territory_id
    JOIN sales_order_line sol ON sol.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN product p           ON p.product_id = sol.product_id
    WHERE st.name = 'Central'
      AND so.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND so.order_date <  DATE '2026-01-01'
    GROUP BY p.product_number, so.order_date
),
explode AS (
    SELECT code, d, qty, 0 AS depth
    FROM lines
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c.child_code, e.d, e.qty * c.qty, e.depth + 1
    FROM explode e
    JOIN u_composition c
      ON c.parent_code = e.code
     AND c.valid_from <= e.d
     AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR e.d <= c.valid_to)
    JOIN product pp ON pp.product_number = e.code
    WHERE e.depth = 0 OR pp.make_flag
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) AS total_demand
FROM explode
WHERE code = 'MS-2348';
```
